title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Take Competing Claims to UN Security Council
detail: Ethiopia told the UN Security Council it is taking self-defense measures against Eritrea, accusing Asmara of an 'all-out invasion' with troops reportedly pushed up to about 60 km into Tigray. Eritrea asked the Council to condemn Ethiopia's 'declaration of war' and take deterrent measures, calling the incursion claims a pretext. Both claims are unverified independently.
